item.title: Severe Cold Wave Continues in J&K and Ladakh; Shopian Records -8.2°C, Pulwama -8°C
item.description: J&K, Jan 10 : Harsh winter conditions persisted across Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh, with sub-zero temperatures recorded in most areas during the night between Friday and Saturday.
